game.title: Resident Evil 3 (2020 remake)
game.build_notes: Verified 2026-10-10 on the Steam build with REFramework rev 76298bd plus the Visceral patch as dinput8.dll. With no headset connected REFramework logs 'Could not create openxr system: XR_ERROR_FORM_FACTOR_UNAVAILABLE' and the game runs flat, first-person, in the window. This REFramework build reads re2_fw_config.txt and writes re2_framework_log.txt even in RE3. Driver: visceral-re3-vr/dev-archive/tools/re3drive.py (a copy of re2drive.py with RE3's path, exe and window title).

input.api: Win32 keyboard via SendInput scancodes (same as RE2; see resident-evil-2-2019.json for the numpad and mouse notes, not yet re-checked here).

bindings.context: main menu and Story submenu (footer: 'Space Confirm')

states.description: RESIDENT EVIL 3 logo on the left, 'START GAME' under it, Nemesis behind.
MAIN MENU: Story / Bonuses / Options / Exit, Story highlighted.
STORY: Continue / Load Game / New Game, Continue highlighted.
First-person street; the Visceral plugin logs 'weapon: WP0000 G19' once the player is bound.

routes.goal: From boot to a loaded game via Continue (last save; never overwrites).
routes.reliability: one clean run (2026-10-10) with a capture check at each menu

steps.command: python re3drive.py launch (the game folder as working directory)

steps.note: until the log has 'Lua state initialized' (about 40 s)

routes.goal: Close the game without killing it.

steps.command: python re3drive.py close (WM_CLOSE to the main window)

saves.lands: a city street at night with a zombie close in front; Jill with the G19

hazards.hazard: The Continue save lands with a zombie a few metres ahead; do not idle long in gameplay.
Without a headset the Visceral plugin's motion-name log stays silent (it only runs while FirstPerson drives a VR view), so the animation playing cannot be read from the log in flat runs.
